First, note:  
Europe/Paris in 1740 likely used local mean time, but for this exercise we assume UTC+0 (since standard time zones didn't exist yet; Paris solar time ~ UTC+0:09, but we'll use UTC+0 as per typical simplification).  
Asia/Singapore standard offset = UTC+8.  

Source time: 01:00 (Paris, assumed UTC+0)  
Target offset = +8  
Target time = 01:00 + 8 = 09:00 same calendar date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 09:00
